n: Parallax cyber:bot AI, Machine Learning and Vision tutorial
t: Tutorials that teach machine learning and vision with the cyber:bot and a HUSKYLENS camera.
steps: Find the Parallax tutorial pages for the cyber:bot and HUSKYLENS.
Obtain a cyber:bot kit and a HUSKYLENS camera.
Choose the MakeCode edition or the Python edition.
Ask IT to approve the software.
Connect the camera to the robot.
Follow the course on training the camera to recognize colors.
Build the Gatekeeper Robot after the color course.
